items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Terminology 59:1
items.html: Malchut of the Rosh [head], where the coarseness of the screen serves from below upward, is called “Peh [mouth].” (Part 4, Chapter 1, Item 3)
